nativeGeometryEdit.directionContract: Six-line contract immediately above SStudioWorkspace::GeometryObjectEditor; existing sidebar-only native Operate world.
nativeGeometryEdit.ownership: Geometry inspector owns object name, case-meter position, degree rotation and positive source-axis scale. Source bytes/hash, import units, patches and material assignments retain their ownership.
nativeGeometryEdit.transform: Original coordinates are converted by retained import units, scaled along original mesh axes, rotated about the original source origin, then translated in case meters. The pivot is not the mesh center.
nativeGeometryEdit.precision: Shortest decimal that round-trips to the stored double; long values retain native field scrolling and full-value tooltips. Unchanged Euler values, including text-only formatting changes, preserve the stored quaternion exactly. Changed angles normalize a new quaternion and may display an equivalent Euler representation after Apply.
nativeGeometryEdit.validation: Trimmed name of 1–120 characters; finite position within ±1e8 meters, angles within ±360000 degrees, positive scale up to 1e8, and transformed bounds within the supported coordinate range. Invalid text remains with Amber recovery and error-field focus.

drafts.retain: Per project/object across workspace and object switching; object list asterisk identifies dirty/conflicting forms.
drafts.preview: Applied object · unapplied edits not shown. Typing and focus loss do not alter the applied case or mesh.
drafts.apply: Apply changes or Enter commits valid name/transform together in one case undo step after selected original mesh verification.
drafts.revert: Reload current applied values; a conflicting external object edit disables Apply until Revert. Byte-identical relocation and material assignment do not conflict.
drafts.save: Save/project-replacement guard returns to the unresolved form, including while another object source is being read. Unfinished text is not saved as applied data.
drafts.removed: Retain disabled text, state no mesh is previewed, offer Discard removed object's edits above the form, and focus that enabled action when save redirects. Discard clears the matching guard without resurrecting the object.
drafts.historyAndIsolation: Applied values persist exactly with case undo/redo. Recording/frame, saved Solve camera, frozen run configuration, source and patch identities and material assignments remain independent.

layout.fields: Object name, Position, Rotation and Scale. Three equal-width fields per transform group, 6-unit gaps, labels 4 units above inputs, 12 units below groups.
layout.recovery: Source-axis/origin explanation above adjacent Apply/Revert; wrapped recovery and lower source diagnostics share the scroll container. Removed-object recovery appears above the disabled retained form.

rules.name: The Independent Encodings Rule
rules.body: Vector color follows the selected scalar; vector direction and proportional length follow velocity. Selecting Pressure does not turn arrow length into pressure.

rules.name: The Single Recovery Rule
rules.body: Keep rejected drafts visible and the previous applied value active. Show the complete wrapped recovery message inside the popover without a duplicate default error popup.

rules.name: The Captured Key Rule
rules.body: Show length, sampled maximum speed, arrow count, and frame identity from the geometry actually presented. Preserve that meaning in annotated export.

rules.name: The Aggregate Ownership Rule
rules.body: Prefix combined seed and trace counts with “All seed sets:” in a selected seed editor. Do not present those totals as selected-object counts.

rules.name: The Frozen Trace Meaning Rule
rules.body: Annotated export must identify instantaneous velocity streamlines, their derived interpolation when applicable, and captured work-limit exhaustion from the frozen snapshot identity and summary.

rules.name: The Single View Owner Rule
rules.body: Keep direction, projection, triangle display, Fit, expansion and camera settings together below the input hint; retain sidebar-only workspace navigation and the separate saved-camera manager.

rules.name: The Explicit Topology Rule
rules.body: Show exact supplied or verified-derived connectivity with its provenance; never substitute a fabricated lattice, partial mesh, or implicit point triangulation.

rules.name: The Single Solve Owner Rule
rules.body: Keep Setup, Physics, BCs and Display inside one right inspector; category changes must preserve the scientific document, frame, camera and render revision. The sidebar remains the sole persistent workspace navigator.

rules.name: The Draft Identity Rule
rules.body: Retain unfinished display-editor text only within its project, solver instance and selected scalar; discard cached forms when any of those identities changes.

rules.name: The Applied Case Rule
rules.body: Show the applied case independently of retained text, and require Apply before draft values can change the case. Preserve the recording, saved Solve camera and frozen run configurations.

rules.name: The Rendered Layers Rule
rules.body: Derive both the viewport badge and inspector layer text from the same renderable-draft predicate used by the painter; never claim that invalid or conflicting text has an outline.

rules.name: The Containment Evidence Rule
rules.body: Report source/aggregate geometry verification separately from whether each object fits inside the applied domain.

rules.name: The Available Recovery Rule
rules.body: When an object is removed, retain its unapplied text, state that no mesh is being previewed for it, and direct saving to the enabled Discard action. Never instruct the user to use disabled Apply/Revert controls.

dos: Do keep sample limits, length mode, exact scale, and the current-frame key together in the vector popover.
Do identify original-row sampling, zero or missing samples, and equal-length direction-only meaning.
Do retain selected-scalar coloring independently of velocity direction and length.
